steps.content:
Several days after Coquelic's arrest
Ruins of the Garden's hideout

steps.speaker: Garden Member
steps.content: ...After you left, the Mentor became listless. She often sat by the window, as if waiting for someone's return.

steps.speaker: Garden Member
steps.content: No one dared to disturb her. We were all hoping you'd bring back good news to lift her spirits.

steps.speaker: Garden Member
steps.content: And then the MBCC came. They came heavily armed—with guns, shields, and whatnot, catching us completely off guard.

steps.speaker: Garden Member
steps.content: We wanted to cover the Mentor so that she could escape to safety, but she thought we were cramping her style and told us to scram...

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: So you chickened out and ran away?

steps.speaker: Garden Member
steps.content: What else could we have done? The Mentor couldn't withstand their firepower, even after deploying that power of hers. We didn't want to see her efforts go to waste, so...

steps.speaker: Garden Member
steps.content: The Mentor must have thought we would be of no help even if we stayed... Thistle, where are you going? Thistle...

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Where do you think I'm going?

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: To the goddamned MBCC, is where I'm going. I'm going to bring the Mentor back!

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Whatever it takes... I can't stand the thought of the Mentor, badly wounded, being kept in that hellhole designed to lock up Sinners.
Night has fallen. Tonight, the MBCC is a restless beast, and even the patrols are less orderly than usual. A guard spots a shadowy figure and walks over to investigate.
A dull thud... A pale hand picks up the fallen walkie-talkie. A side door opens, and the figure slips into the Bureau building.

Hours after Coquelic's attack on the Chief
MBCC Chief's break room
She is in a coma, and still her vital signs are deteriorating? Is the situation that grim?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. You can refer to the medical log I've sent you for the details. Simply put, almost all her vital signs are problematic, and her prognosis is poor.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is partly due to the depletion of her life force, which was, in turn, caused by the overuse of her Mania power. It was a miracle she could move around the way she did, considering the condition her body was in.
And she still tried to kill me using her Mania power... Looks like she was determined to take me down with her.
You open the medical log sent by Nightingale. The projected image is crowded with large patches of red. You furrow your brow at the sight.
These red patches seem to you a manifestation of that comatose patient's determination to send you to hell, even at the cost of her own life.
The Garden's strongest Sinner, top assassin, Mentor... Coquelic. I understand why she wanted to kill me. But at the cost of her own life?
She almost died in her attempt to kill me. No assassin organization would make a losing deal of that magnitude. Unless... the reward for taking my life was too great to resist.
That reward was her motivation, the thing that might show us who she really is beneath her fanatical exterior. What could it be?
Your instinct tells you that to unravel this mystery, you have to delve into Coquelic's past.

Someone at the Bureau was deeply involved in the investigation into the assassination of Paradeisos officials that was choreographed by Coquelic. This person may be able to provide you with some insight.
Is Christina at the Bureau now? I need... Cough... I need to talk to her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, didn't you say you would rest right after hearing the report?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Or does time work differently in your world?

Hecate, who has taken it upon herself to look after you and make sure you have enough rest, looks at you, her somewhat solemn eyes making you feel a tinge of guilt. And it is clear that Nightingale isn't going to take your side this time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: According to the record, Sinner Christina has applied to leave the premises in accordance with the Sinner Bail Regulations. She's currently involved in an investigation initiated by the Eastside Public Security Bureau, having reported that she might be unreachable for a while.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Looks like you can't use your I'll-rest-right-after excuse this time, Chief. You may have forgotten this, but Hecate and I sure haven't: You've just survived an assassination attempt and are severely injured. Please, be a good patient and rest now.
All right, all right, I'll rest now. I'll talk to her when she returns. Resting is my first priority now. See? I'm turning off the projector.
With the projector off, the room is now in semi-darkness. To put the other two's minds at ease, you make to lie down, rearranging the thin blanket wrapped around your chest and waist.
You're feeling dizzy, nauseated, cold... Thanks to Coquelic, you have little choice but to take a break from your official duties and stay on bed rest.
And then the silence of the room is broken by a distant explosion. You become fully alert.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: <size=30>...What's wrong? Wasn't the location covered by the patrol routes of the guards? And no eyewitness reports?</size>
Nightingale, what happened? Was that an explosion?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes, it happened just a minute ago, near the northeast side door. I'm organizing a search for the suspects.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Judging by the available information, it's tentatively determined to be an attack on the Bureau, and it's likely that the attacker has infiltrated...
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Nightingale has hardly finished talking when more explosions take place in rapid succession, each sounding closer than the last.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you all right?
I'm okay... Cough, cough, cough...
The vibrations from the consecutive explosions compound the dizziness, making you, already short of breath, gasp for air.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Supervision Center...?! No... pattern...?! So many... Could it be...? More than one... person?
To make matters worse, one of the explosions has interfered with the communication devices, and your conversation with Nightingale is cut short.
Is this also part of the attacker's plan? Cough... That's quite impressive, I must admit...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Can't believe someone has managed to break into the Bureau, and in such a haphazard fashion. Didn't this person worry that they would get hurt because of the explosions?
I don't think it was haphazard. It seemed like a clever move to me...
Consider the explosions. They were not large in scale. It's unlikely they were aimed at demolishing buildings or causing destruction. Cough... The explosions are probably a means to an end...
Still, it was a violent means of distraction. Who knows how much more violent it can be when it comes time for the attacker to achieve the end?
In any case, before we figure out the true purpose of the attack, we must... cough... proceed with caution...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I understand. Chief, you shouldn't be talking.
Then comes a frantic knock on the door.
Are you still in there, Chief? Better hurry and take shelter. It'll be too late once smoke appears.
The door, which hasn't been securely closed, opens, and Hecate's sharp eyes take in that familiar medical attire.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Did Adjutant Nightingale send you? The Chief isn't feeling well. Do you have any medicine with you?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: The elevator's out of service, and I wasn't able to bring the cart up here. I only have a few common medications on me.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: What's wrong with the Chief? Let me see if there's anything... Ahhh!
The nurse has been in the room for just a few minutes when another explosion occurs, closer still. The floor shakes, and she loses her balance and lurches forward.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are you all right?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: (Groans) I'm fine, I'm fine. Let me see if there's any medication that can alleviate your discomfort.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: And we need to get out of here now, Chief. You might have to suffer for a while longer. This most recent explosion was very close. It's more likely than not that the attacker is coming for you.
Cough... Thank you.
But we shouldn't leave this place. And it is precisely because the attacker is coming for me.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Huh?
The first explosion was to attract attention, the second to destroy communication... Cough... This attacker is not only skilled but also purposeful.
So this most recent explosion, even though it couldn't destroy any building, it must have served a purpose...
Like... to lure you out of safety into their turf.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Ah, I think I get it now! The enemy expects us to evacuate after the explosion, and if we do, we'll fall right into their trap!

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: So it's better to stay here and wait for rescue. That way, when Adjutant Nightingale sends people to help us, they'll know where to find us.
Cough, cough... Exactly.
You and Hecate may have some work to do, though. We need to hold out here until Nightingale arrives with reinforcements, and there might be more explosions or other forms of attack in the meantime.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Leave it to us! But... there isn't much I can do here, other than to help alleviate the Chief's discomfort.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: If the attacker really...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If the attacker really comes, I'll handle them.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'll guard the door. Anyone who wants to harm the Chief has to get past me and Nightmare first.
Your analysis has eased the minds of the young nurse and Hecate, and they have found what they can do to help. You lean back and breathe a sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Hey, Hecate, come take a look at this...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hmm... Ahhh!
Hecate!!!
It's happened all too quickly. The nurse, who was full of concern just a minute ago, has struck Hecate on the back of the neck with the side of her hand, knocking Hecate out. You sit up abruptly.
Then she draws a Fire Blade from her waist, her eyes murderous.
Cough... So you're the attacker. Your plan was effective, and your reactions were quick. You've won, I concede.
If you want to kill me, be my guest. But before you do so, at least let me know who I've lost to.
You can't make out the attacker's face, but her murderous intention is unmistakable. The situation is dire, and you must find a way to save yourself.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Fishing for information, huh? Even when you're so close to death.
You don't have to be so guarded. Let's talk. You're young. Cough... You probably don't think much about the consequences before acting, right?
Well, you should. I'm the Chief of the MBCC, a position of no small importance. If you strike me down, whoever has put you up to this might be able to get out of this unscathed, but you...
You don't spell out the consequences the assassin might face, in case they're construed as a threat. But you believe she understands what is implied.
I give you my word that if you make a deal with me, I'll let all of this go. That way, you can achieve your goal more easily, without all this...

She has done a good job of disguising herself, but her youthfulness and the aura of malice are unmistakable. These are the few clues you must take advantage of, if you wish to stir her emotionally and stop her from killing you.
Moreover, the more scornful she is of you, the more certain you are that she's hiding something.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: You can stop this pathetic attempt to stall for time. I won't fall for it.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: I can get what I want without making a deal with you. I only have to kill you to get it!
The attacker steps over the various pieces of furniture you've overturned in an attempt to buy time, going for your vulnerable spots; she is merciless, determined, and extremely calm.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: So... Die now!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Nightmare!
At this critical juncture, Hecate wakes up. In a hoarse voice, she shouts, "Nightmare!" Nightmare swoops in and hurls a heavy table at the assassin.
The assassin dodges the table, but only narrowly. A sharp corner of the table grazes her face, damaging her disguise.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Tsk tsk, what a nuisance.
A stranger's face?
How could there be two strangers in such a short time span who would go to any lengths to kill you?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, watch out!
You duck just in time to avoid the projectile. Thanks to Hecate and Nightmare, you've managed to put some distance between you and the assassin, but she is still too close for comfort.
You'll be cornered, if you don't do something soon. The fire and the assassin... You must find a way to break the deadlock.
While the assassin is busy fighting Nightmare, you grab anything that lies near you and throw them at her, hoping to distract her. Bottles, cups, documents... even your communication device.

It is an act of desperation. Surprisingly, it works wonders. Right after you throw the last object at your disposal, a red light appears in the room. It's a shade of red different from that of the Fire Blade.

The light is coming from the projector, which you've turned on by accident. Coquelic's medical log is being displayed. The numbers and letters in the log are either white or red, as is Coquelic's face in the photo. The assassin's face is illuminated.
She stares at the pale face in the photo, frozen.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Seize the opportunity, rescue the Chief!
You hear a familiar voice. It's Nightingale. She's arrived with reinforcements. The staff members and Sinners swarm in and quickly restrain the assassin.
You are hurried to the side, to a safe zone set up by the Sinners. One of them even has had a thin blanket ready for you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, are you all right? Do you need to rest? No? All right, please don't push yourself too hard.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Here is the current state of affairs: The attacker has been apprehended, the fire is being extinguished, and on account of the satisfactory execution of the disaster response plan, the explosions did not result in any casualties.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Given this person's high Threat Rating and aggressive behavior, I suggest we put her in solitary confinement for now. We can consider how to proceed from there after a thorough investigation.
Hmm...

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Don't you dare!

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: I'm gonna kill you! Just wait and see. I'm gonna kill you!
You look at the assassin, who is pinned down but still looking daggers at you. She's gripping the terminal so hard that its casing is creaking. She is still dangerous.

But you won't forget that unexpected moment when she was at a complete loss, when her true self surfaced, though only for a split second. It was the sight of Coquelic's medical log that drew this reaction from her.
This may be the window of opportunity you've been waiting for.
No, don't put her in solitary. Get the interrogation room ready. I want to interrogate her now.
No doubt she'll be useful in helping me solve the puzzle that's been nagging at me lately.
